claim.text: RMSNorm divides each coordinate by the root mean square of the vector, so a larger epsilon stops that division from shri

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var eps = state.eps; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var vals = [1, -2, 0.5, 3]; var ms = 0; var i = 0; var rms = 0; var bw = 0; var bh = 0; var bx = 0; var base = 0; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); for (i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) { ms = ms + vals[i] * vals[i]; } rms = Math.sqrt(ms / vals.length + eps); bw = (w - 80) / vals.length; base = h - 80; ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillText("eps = " + fmt(eps), 24, 30); ctx.fillText("rms = " + fmt(rms), 24, 50); ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(16, base); ctx.lineTo(w - 16, base); ctx.stroke(); for (i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) { bh = Math.abs(vals[i] / rms) * 110; if (base - bh < 60) { bh = base - 60; } bx = 40 + i * bw; ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(bx, base - bh, bw - 18, bh); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("x" + fmt(vals[i]), bx, base + 18); ctx.fillText("y" + fmt(vals[i] / rms), bx, base - bh - 8); } ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("y = x / rms, rms grows with eps", 24, h - 24); }
widget.title: Epsilon brakes what RMS shrinks
